proposals: South East Central Railway should publish every Section 20A land schedule as a machine-readable table — village, survey number, named landholders and area with its unit spelled out — alongside the gazette scan, so that nobody has to infer from OCR whether 0.0093 is hectares.

The Ministry of Railways should cite, in each Section 20A notification, the project’s approved cost, route length, added capacity and the reference of the Cabinet or Railway Board approval, so the ₹2,223 crore, 84.10 km and 52 MTPA figures can be checked against a primary document rather than trade coverage.

The Competent Authority at Tirora, under the Maharashtra Revenue Department, should publish a register of objections received under Section 20D(1) for the Tumkheda Bk. schedule, with hearing dates and outcomes by survey number, so the 30-day objection window is visible as a record and not only as a legal right.

The Ministry of Railways should publish a per-project land-acquisition tracker for the Dongargarh–Gondia Fourth Line, showing hectares notified, acquired and compensated by village and tehsil, so the farm-plot level of the project can be followed from first notification to completion.
